components.name: Chart/Funnel
components.description: Conversion through ordered steps (onboarding, checkout, loan application). Stepped = bars + flow area between steps with step-to-step conversion; Horizontal = centred bars with count and share of the first step. 3–7 steps, same unit for all. The biggest drop gets the AI insight or annotation. React: <FunnelChart steps variant="stepped|horizontal" />
